description: Clear all reactions from a message, or all of one emoji. Safe to call directly: the first call changes nothing and returns a preview plus a confirm_token; repeating the call with the token executes. Relay the preview for the user's go-ahead.

emoji.description: Only clear this emoji; omit to clear everything.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

name: clear_reactions
title: Clear reactions
